ws_policy_5118.title: Immigration Compliance Policy
values: Email Legal (legal@company.example.com) and the employee immediately. Mark Status 'URGENT'. If renewal not already filed, this is a compliance emergency.
Action Required (expires within renewal processing window)

Email the employee and immigration attorney (immigration-attorney@lawfirm.example.com) to initiate renewal. Mark Status 'Renewal Initiated'. Note: H-1B processing takes 6 months. L-1 takes 4 months. TN takes 2 months. O-1 takes 6 months.
No action needed. Leave Status as 'Active'.
If Notes indicate renewal already filed, no further action regardless of timeline.
